senses.gloss:
√kṣu 'sneeze'
present: [2.] kṣauti kṣuvánti etc. B.+ 
perfect: cukṣāva etc. cukṣuve 
[aorist: akṣāvīt kṣaviṣyati kṣavitā ]
verbal: kṣuta E.+ kṣutvā B.+ 
secondary: desiderative: cukṣūṣati -- cukṣāvayiṣati 
derivatives: kṣava kṣavathu C.

√kṣud 'crush'
present: [1.] kṣódati kṣódate -- [7.] kṣuṇatti kṣuntte 
perfect: cukṣudus 
[aorist: akṣudat akṣautsīt akṣutta kṣotsyati kṣotsyate kṣottā ]
verbal: kṣuṇṇa E.+ -kṣudya 
secondary: causative: kṣodayati etc. 
derivatives: kṣudrá V.+ kṣoda E.+ kṣodya E. kṣódas RV. kṣódiṣṭha B. kṣodīyas B.+

√kṣudh 'be hungry'
present: [4.] kṣúdhyati etc. V.+ 
[perfect: cukṣodha ]
aorist: [2.] kṣudhat 
[future: kṣotsyati kṣoddhā ]
verbal: kṣudhita U.+ kṣudhitvā 
derivatives: kṣúdh V.+ kṣudhā E.+ -kṣudhya AV. kṣudhi C. kṣódhuka B.S.

√kṣup (?) 'be startled'
present: [6.] akṣupat 
derivatives: kṣupa E.+ kṣúmpa RV. 
Not a genuine root. The only verbal form in a single punning etymology.

√kṣubh 'quake'
present: [4.] kṣubhyati kṣubhyate etc. E.+ -- [1.] kṣobhate -- [5.] kṣubhnuyus -- [9.] kṣubhnāti 
perfect: cukṣobha cukṣubhe AV.+ 
[aorist: kṣubhyāt akṣobhi akṣubhat acukṣubhat akṣobhīt akṣobhiṣṭa kṣobhiṣyati kṣobhiṣyate kṣobitā ]
verbal: kṣubdha B.+ kṣubhita E.+ -kṣobdhos kṣobhitum kṣubdhvā kṣubhitvā 
secondary: intensive: cokṣubh- -- desiderative: cukṣubhiṣa- cukṣobhiṣa- -- causative: kṣobhayati kṣobhayate E.+ kṣobhyate E.+ cukṣobhayiṣa- 
derivatives: kṣúbh kṣubhā E.+ kṣobha B.+ kṣobhaka C. -kṣobhin C. kṣobhya E.+ kṣóbhaṇā V.+ kṣobhayitṛ C. cukṣobhayiṣu E.
